package.name: zmr_sim
package.description: Dependency-free headless 2D simulator for the ZMR AMR. Integrates differential-drive kinematics from /cmd_vel, ray-casts a 2D LiDAR against an occupancy-grid world, and publishes /scan, /odom, /joint_states and TF - exactly the interfaces the real robot exposes. No Gazebo, no GUI, no rendering: it runs on a headless machine and in CI.
